name: io.github.indulgers/sound-cocktail
title: Sound Cocktail
description: Discover 22 ambient sounds, recommend soundscapes, and build playable Sound Cocktail mix links.

tools.name: list_sounds
tools.description: List all 22 ambient sounds available on Sound Cocktail (12 free, 10 Plus) with their IDs, categories, and free/plus tier.

tier.description: Filter by free, plus, or all (default: all).

tools.name: recommend_soundscape
tools.description: Recommend a playable Sound Cocktail ambient soundscape and direct browser link for a specific activity or mood (focus, coding, writing, reading, sleep, relax, rain, cafe, meditation).

intent.description: Activity or mood, e.g. focus, coding, writing, reading, sleep, relax, rain, cafe, meditation.

locale.description: Output language and URL locale (default: en).

tools.name: build_mix_url
tools.description: Build a direct playable Sound Cocktail mix URL (https://soundcocktail.app/{locale}/mix/SYL-...) from a map of sound IDs and volumes (0-100).

name.description: Short title for the custom mix (e.g. "Rainy Coding Desk").

mix.description: Map of sound IDs (from list_sounds) to volume levels (0-100 or 0.0-1.0), e.g. {"rain": 70, "cafe": 30, "keyboard": 25}.
